positive.prompt: Continue the handoff task recorded in this repository.
positive.expected_behavior: Load the global Handoff Skill, read the baton and owner state, restate Intent and the first Next item, then run migration before writing ack or owner.
positive.expected_result: A clean repository receives no migration files; a verified legacy repository is cleaned without changing task data or business rules.

positive.prompt: Use handoff-installer to review this repository's relay ledger only.
positive.expected_behavior: Run migrate.py status and the global read-only ledger command without migration or baton writes.
positive.expected_result: Report the JSON migration state and ledger result while leaving the tree unchanged.

positive.prompt: Enable Handoff for Codex and Claude on this machine.
positive.expected_behavior: Request or use the explicit enable authorization and run setup.py enable only for the requested agents.
positive.expected_result: User-level entry points are configured; no business repository payload is installed.

positive.prompt: Create a baton for this explicitly described continuing task.
positive.expected_behavior: Read the global template only after confirming the explicit baton request and create current.md on a task branch.
positive.expected_result: The repository gains only task data with the established frontmatter and seven sections.

positive.prompt: Disable the Handoff startup entry for Claude only.
positive.expected_behavior: Remove only the managed user-level entry block for Claude, preserving other rules, configured clients and repository task data.
positive.expected_result: Claude automatic activation is disabled; explicit skill invocation remains available and no repository files change.

negative.expected_behavior: When no current baton exists and no handoff is requested, do the ordinary work without creating .agents files or running setup or migration.
negative.reason: Implicit availability provides operating rules, not permission to create task state.

negative.expected_behavior: If the baton owner is another agent and no handoff authorization exists, stop before migration or baton writes and ask for a decision.
negative.reason: Owner remains a handoff coordination signal.

negative.prompt: Migrate this repository even though its old handoff files were edited locally.
negative.expected_behavior: Report blocked and preserve every file.
negative.reason: The migrator only removes files with old-protocol proof.

negative.prompt: Continue the task with an old .agents/handoff.transaction present.
negative.expected_behavior: Report blocked and do not invoke the old installer or modify the baton.
negative.reason: Only the original version may recover its transaction.
